cyd32-st7798.title: SquachEmit CYD 3.2 — 172-Case UAV Detection Suite + Smooth Touch
cyd32-st7798.summary: Current 172-case CYD 3.2 ST7798 firmware: 27 new UAV vendor-prefix Wi-Fi test beacons, 3–30-second saved TX TIME editor, reduced touchscreen flashing and animated Squachy. The browser installer SHA-256 checks all four firmware segments before flashing. This is a current mainline build, not the original 95-case v1.0.0 release.
highlights: 172 bounded synthetic BLE/Wi-Fi scenarios; per-case locally administered MAC IDs.
TX TIME [SET] with +/- 1 second, RESET 12 and DONE; persists after reboot.
Routine touches and duration changes avoid unnecessary full-screen redraws.
STOP, SUITE and transmit auto-timeout remain.
Installer verifies bootloader, partition table, OTA selector and application.
Manufacturer-only prefixes do not authenticate a real drone.

c5-waveshare-28.title: SquachEmit Waveshare C5 — 172-Case BLE + Wi-Fi Detection Suite
c5-waveshare-28.summary: Current Waveshare ESP32-C5 2.8-inch touchscreen build with the shared 172-case synthetic BLE/Wi-Fi test suite including 27 added UAV vendor-prefix beacons and synthetic Remote ID profiles. The browser installer validates the four firmware segments by SHA-256. The CYD 3.2-specific saved TX-time touchscreen is not included on C5.
highlights: 172 shared detection cases and negative controls.
27 UAV vendor Wi-Fi test beacons; no genuine drone RF claim.
Controlled, time-limited tests with serial truth reporting.
Four-part SHA-256 preflight, including C5 bootloader at 0x2000.
Requires exact Waveshare C5 2.8-inch touch hardware.

s3-devkit.title: SquachEmit ESP32-S3 — 172-Case Serial Signal Test Suite
s3-devkit.summary: Current ESP32-S3 DevKitC-1 build of the shared 172-case synthetic BLE/Wi-Fi test suite, including UAV vendor-prefix beacon tests and synthetic Remote ID profiles. Serial RUN/STOP/SUITE control remains. Browser flashing now verifies all four firmware segments by SHA-256. The CYD 3.2-specific TX-time screen is not available on this board.
highlights: 172 shared synthetic scenarios and negative controls.
USB serial RUN, STOP and SUITE for bounded transmitter tests.
Vendor OUI-only beacons are not authentic aircraft broadcasts.
No CYD touchscreen interface is claimed for S3.
